name: Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit

submission.postalAddress: Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit, Alt-Moabit 59-61, 10555 Berlin, Germany

procedural.notes: The BlnBDI is competent for controllers established in Berlin (private sector and Berlin state public bodies). Complaints can be filed via the dedicated webform at kontakt.datenschutz-berlin.de, by email to mailbox@datenschutz-berlin.de, or by post to Alt-Moabit 59-61, 10555 Berlin. Working language is German; the authority does not publish an English-language complaint channel. Berlin has a track record of public enforcement against media and adtech actors and was the first German DPA to issue a major GDPR fine (Deutsche Wohnen, 2019).
